Plot a panel quantile regression fit

Source: R/plot-panqr.R
plot.panqr.Rd

Base-graphics plot of the coefficients of a panqr() fit across the estimated quantiles, one panel per term: the estimates joined by a line, a shaded pointwise Wald confidence band (from the same variances as confint()), and a dashed reference line at zero. With a single quantile each panel shows the estimate and its interval. Without a covariance (vcov = "none") only the estimates are drawn.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'panqr'
plot(
  x,
  parm = NULL,
  level = 0.95,
  ncol = NULL,
  col = "black",
  band = "grey85",
  main = NULL,
  xlab = expression(tau),
  ylab = "Estimate",
  ...
)

Arguments

x

a "panqr" fit

parm

names or positions of the terms to plot; all by default

level

confidence level of the bands

ncol

number of panel columns; by default up to three

col

colour of the estimates

band

colour of the confidence bands

main

optional titles, recycled over the terms; the term names by default

xlab

horizontal-axis label

ylab

vertical-axis label

...

additional arguments passed to graphics::plot.default()

Value

x, invisibly

See also

Other panqr methods: summary.panqr(), vcov.panqr()

Examples

set.seed(2)
d <- data.frame(id = rep(1:100, each = 5), t = rep(1:5, 100))
d$x <- rnorm(500) + rep(rnorm(100), each = 5)
d$y <- d$x + rep(rnorm(100), each = 5) + (1 + 0.2 * abs(d$x)) * rnorm(500)
fit <- panqr(y ~ x, data = d, index = c("id", "t"),
             tau = c(0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9), model = "mmqr")
plot(fit)
